title: Clean pending publish open actions
summary: Cleaned Pending Publish open controls and diagnostics wording. The Pending page no longer shows the duplicate Open Parked File action, no longer offers a Pending-local Read Last Stderr action or Review in Diagnostics bridge, and labels the allowlisted pending_publish folder action as Open Pending Folder. Backend destination-folder opens now fall back to a useful existing destination ancestor when the planned movie folder is not present yet.
reason: Operators need the Pending Publish actions to match the actual workflow: play/open parked output is one action, the pending_publish diagnostics target opens a folder, and a planned destination folder may not exist until publish/drain creates it.
behavior_before: Pending selected-row diagnostics offered Read Last Stderr and Review in Diagnostics, folder-open actions said Open Pending Publish, the row-open action strip showed both Play Parked Output and Open Parked File, and Open Destination Folder could fail when the planned destination folder did not exist yet.
behavior_after: Pending selected-row diagnostics focus on row/folder/log opens without Last Stderr or Review in Diagnostics, pending_publish folder opens are labeled Open Pending Folder, only Play Parked Output remains for parked media, and destination-folder open selects an existing destination folder ancestor when needed.
manual_validation: ops/pipeline/runtime/PowerShell-7.6.0-win-x64/pwsh.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ops/scripts/release/test.ps1 -SkipToolIntegration -SkipEndToEndSmoke -- failed: broad repo gates have unrelated stale generated artifacts, dependency-boundary drift, unrelated unit failures, and older packet MP-CHANGE-2026-0630-015 contains an unredacted local path
rollback_plan: Revert the WebView label/action removals, restore the previous pending_publish destination-folder parent selection in pending_open_policy.py, and rerun the focused pending publish and WebView diagnostics tests.
notes:
